title: Sum of All Subset XOR Totals: Every Mix of Tint Pots
summary: Walk the take-or-skip tree; each leaf is one mix, and its XOR total joins the running sum.

analogy.scenario: A painter has tint pots coded 2 and 5. Adding a pot flips certain color channels, so a mix's shade code is the XOR of its pots' codes. What do the shade codes of every possible mix, including no pots, add up to?

mapping.real: Adding or leaving out a pot
mapping.abstract: Take or skip: one branch each

takeaway.summary: At each item, branch twice: take it, then skip it. Every leaf is one subset; carry its running value down so each leaf costs nothing extra.
whenToUse: Small inputs where all combinations matter

scenes.narration: A painter has two tint pots, coded 2 and 5. A mix's shade code is the XOR of its pots. Add up the codes of every mix, including the empty one.
scenes.caption: Pots 2 and 5: add up the shade code of every mix

scenes.narration: Each pot is either in the mix or out, so the mixes form a tree: one level per pot, two branches each.
scenes.caption: Each pot: in or out. That's a tree of choices

scenes.narration: Start with pot 2 in. The shade code so far is 0 XOR 2, which is 2.
scenes.caption: Take pot 2: the shade code is 2

scenes.narration: Add pot 5 as well: 2 XOR 5 is 7. Every pot is decided, so this mix is done, and 7 joins the sum.
scenes.caption: Both pots: 2 XOR 5 = 7, the first mix

scenes.narration: Back up one level and take pot 5 out, so the other branch can try leaving it out.
scenes.caption: Back up: take pot 5 out again

scenes.narration: Skipping pot 5 leaves the code at 2: another mix, another 2 for the sum. The same happens on the side without pot 2.
scenes.caption: Skip pot 5: the code stays 2

scenes.narration: All four mixes are visited: codes 7, 2, 5, and 0. Their sum is 14.
scenes.caption: Four mixes: 7 + 2 + 5 + 0 = 14

scenes.narration: Pots are numbers, mixes are subsets, and flipping channels is XOR. Take-or-skip backtracking visits all 2 to the n subsets once.
scenes.caption: Pots are numbers; mixes are subsets
